description: This file implements version downgrade and upgrade validation logic for etcd, including version comparison, downgrade detection, and cluster version change validation.

classes.name: DowngradeInfo
classes.description: Struct holding information about a downgrade target version and whether downgrade is enabled.

methods.name: GetTargetVersion
methods.description: Returns the target version as a semver.Version object.

methods.name: isValidDowngrade
methods.description: Checks if downgrading from verFrom to verTo is valid based on allowed downgrade version.

methods.name: MustDetectDowngrade
methods.description: Detects if the local server version is compatible with the cluster version, panics if invalid.

methods.name: allowedDowngradeVersion
methods.description: Returns the allowed downgrade version, typically one minor version lower.

methods.name: IsValidClusterVersionChange
methods.description: Determines if a cluster version change from verFrom to verTo is valid, considering downgrade and upgrade scenarios.
